Consistency-test inversion (the estimator used in the paper)

Source: R/astro_ctest.R
astro_ctest.Rd

After Zeeden et al. (2023): draw a precession constant and a set of secular frequencies, predict every term, and keep the draw only if all measured windows are satisfied at once. Two details matter. First, the secular frequencies are sampled as periods with the Laskar et al. (2011) uncertainties scaled by sqrt(age / 100 Myr). Second, because a record tuned to a nominal 405 kyr inherits the error in the true g2-g5 period, every measured period is rescaled by (sampled 405-kyr period) / 405 before it is compared with the prediction; this is what allows the tuned time scale itself to stretch slightly.

Usage

astro_ctest(
  windows,
  age_ma,
  nsim = 3000,
  k_range = c(10, 34),
  anchor_kyr = 405,
  seed = 1,
  block = 2e+05,
  max_attempts = 5e+07,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

windows

Measured period windows of the astronomical terms, in kyr on the tuned time scale (named list; each element a numeric vector c(low, high)). Allowed names: "e405", "k+s3" (obliquity), "k+g5", "k+g2", "k+g4" and "k+g3" (precession), e.g. list("e405" = c(400, 410), "k+s3" = c(29, 30.4)). A draw is accepted only if every predicted period, rescaled by (sampled 405-kyr period)/anchor_kyr, falls inside its window. Required, no default.

age_ma

Age of the record in Ma (numeric): either c(min, max), or a single value, in which case the range age_ma - 5 to age_ma + 5 Ma is used. Ages are sampled uniformly in this range and scale the uncertainty of the secular frequencies by sqrt(age/100 Myr). Required, no default.

nsim

Number of accepted (consistent) draws to collect (integer, > 0). Default=3000.

k_range

Prior range of the precession constant k in kyr (numeric vector c(min, max)); k is drawn uniformly in this range. Default=c(10, 34).

anchor_kyr

Period (kyr) that was assumed for the 405-kyr eccentricity cycle when the record was tuned (numeric, > 0); the measured windows are rescaled by (sampled 405-kyr period)/anchor_kyr. Default=405.

seed

Seed of the random number generator (integer), passed to set.seed() so that the Monte Carlo results can be reproduced. Default=1.

block

Number of random draws made per iteration of the vectorised search (integer, > 0); larger values are faster but use more memory. Default=2e5.

max_attempts

Maximum total number of draws before the search stops with an error because too few consistent draws were found (numeric, > 0). Default=5e7.

verbose

Print a message with the number of accepted draws and the acceptance rate (logical, TRUE or FALSE). Default=TRUE.
